## Work Order and outcome

Link the Work Order. State the outcome and whether this is documentation, simulated behavior, or live functionality.

## Submission identity and changes

Record the reviewed commit/artifact identity and any uncommitted inputs. Explain important trade-offs without redefining the target.

## Checks actually run

Commands, results, evidence, and unavailable checks. Self-tests are not independent acceptance.

## Independent assessment

Reviewer session/identity, frozen Submission, per-critical-criterion PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED, and original report link. Leave pending when not performed. Do not claim same-account GitHub approval.

## Resource, permission, and publication impact

New dependencies, model usage, host processes, credentials, workflow permissions, public-data risks, or none. Any wider authority requires explicit approval.

## Remaining decisions

Known defects, untested areas, and human acceptance/merge decision. Draft does not mean ready to merge.
